title: Why did one stale package name stop a StagOS build?

glossary.full: The list of module names a product installs

glossary.note: Virtual A/B keeps the second slot as snapshots.

key_points: PRODUCT_PACKAGES accumulates across every inherited makefile.
Each name in it must match a real module, or the build stops.
Removing a stale name fixes the error.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A StagOS build stops on one red line.

visuals.text: error text quoted from the commit message

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Non-existent modules? I haven't added a package all week.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Nobody did. So which assumption broke? Open the case file.

visuals.title: Remove non existent snapuserd.recovery package
visuals.broke: Build stops: includes non-existent modules in PRODUCT_PACKAGES

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: PRODUCT_PACKAGES is one big list. Every name in it must match a real module.
beats.say: PRODUCT PACKAGES is one big list. Every name in it must match a real module.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: One big list, from one file?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: From every makefile you inherit. Lists pile up across them; scalars like PRODUCT_NAME take the most derived value.

visuals.text: lists accumulate, scalars: most derived wins

beats.say: From every makefile you inherit. Lists pile up across them; scalars like PRODUCT NAME take the most derived value.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: So one stale name anywhere stays in the list. Here, it's snapuserd.recovery.

visuals.text: snapuserd.recovery: nothing answers to this name

beats.say: So one stale name anywhere stays in the list. Here, it's snap user D dot recovery.

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: That a recovery build of snapuserd still exists. The commit says the recovery target was removed in an earlier change.
beats.say: That a recovery build of snap user D still exists. The commit says the recovery target was removed in an earlier change.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: Then the fix is just deleting it?

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Yes, from both Virtual A/B compression makefiles. The list shrinks by one name.

visuals.fix: Delete snapuserd.recovery from both compression makefiles

beats.speaker: senior
beats.text: Now every name matches a module again. The commit's test note: run m, and that error is gone.

visuals.why: Every PRODUCT_PACKAGES name resolves to a module again

beats.say: Now every name matches a module again. The commit's test note: run em, and that error is gone.

beats.speaker: rookie
beats.text: One stale word in a list can stop the whole build.
